content.text:
Implemented: Keating’s blog is now an ATProto-backed Standard.site publication, ready for a Tranquil PDS.

Key pieces:

- `/blog` and `/blog/:slug` now read `site.standard.publication` and `site.standard.document` records from the configured PDS.
- Articles use the `at.markpub.markdown` content format.
- Canonical URLs, OpenGraph metadata, `rel="site.standard.document"`, and `/.well-known/site.standard.publication` are generated.
- Added a migration publisher for all 46 legacy posts. Dry-run output contains 47 records: one publication plus 46 documents.
- PDS discovery supports handles, DIDs, and explicit Tranquil/local overrides.
- Added loading, retry, search, tag filtering, and publication-source UI.

Main files:

- [ATProto blog interface](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/src/pages/AtprotoBlog.tsx)
- [PDS reader](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/server/utils/atproto-blog.ts)
- [migration publisher](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/web/scripts/publish-standard-site-blog.ts)
- [deployment and cutover guide](/home/diogenes/Projects/keating/docs/STANDARD_SITE_BLOG.md)

The implementation follows the [Standard.site publication/document contract](https://standard.site/docs/quick-start), its [document lexicon](https://standard.site/docs/lexicons/document), and [Markpub’s ATProto Markdown format](https://markpub.at/). Tranquil is supported as the repository’s PDS using its documented [ATProto-compatible server](https://tangled.org/ptr.pet/tranquil-pds/blob/main/README.md).

Validation completed:

- Full web suite: 634 passing.
- Final focused suite: 11 passing.
- Typecheck and production Nitro build pass.
- Production API, well-known endpoint, and article metadata verified against a mock PDS.
- `/blog` rendered successfully in Chrome with no console errors.
- Diff whitespace checks pass.

The live Tranquil publication was not written because its account and credentials do not exist in this environment. Once provisioned, inject the three publishing secrets and run:

```bash
bun web/scripts/publish-standard-site-blog.ts --write
```

Then configure the deployment with the repository DID/handle and publication AT URI documented in the guide. Vet’s provider-backed review could not run because Anthropic credentials were unavailable; its fallback stalled and was stopped. Existing unrelated worktree changes were preserved.
